description: This file defines the ScheduleGeneratorDTO class, a data transfer object used to encapsulate parameters and dependencies necessary for generating loan repayment schedules within the Apache Fineract project. It includes fields for configuration, calendar handling, interest calculation preferences, and floating rate data.

classes.name: ScheduleGeneratorDTO
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object encapsulating parameters needed for loan schedule generation, including interest calculation details, calendar configurations, and floating rate information.

methods.name: ScheduleGeneratorDTO
methods.description: Constructor initializing all configuration fields necessary for scheduling, including factory, currency, dates, calendar info, and interest-related flags.

methods.name: getLoanScheduleFactory
methods.description: Returns the LoanScheduleGeneratorFactory instance used for generating schedules.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency data associated with this schedule.

methods.name: getCalculatedRepaymentsStartingFromDate
methods.description: Returns the date from which repayment calculations are to start.

methods.name: getCalendarInstanceForInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Returns the calendar instance used for interest recalculation.

methods.name: getRecalculateFrom
methods.description: Returns the start date for recalculation.

methods.name: getRecalculateTill
methods.description: Returns the end date for recalculation.

methods.name: getOverdurPenaltyWaitPeriod
methods.description: Returns the over-due penalty wait period as a Long.

methods.name: getPenaltyWaitPeriod
methods.description: Returns the penalty wait period as an integer, converting from Long if necessary.

methods.name: getHolidayDetailDTO
methods.description: Returns the holiday detail data transfer object.

methods.name: setRecalculateFrom
methods.description: Sets the recalculation start date.

methods.name: getCompoundingCalendarInstance
methods.description: Returns the calendar instance used for compounding.

methods.name: getFloatingRateDTO
methods.description: Returns the floating rate data transfer object.

methods.name: getCalendar
methods.description: Returns the calendar object.

methods.name: getCalendarHistoryDataWrapper
methods.description: Returns the calendar history data wrapper.

methods.name: isInterestChargedFromDateAsDisbursementDateEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether interest is charged from the disbursement date.

methods.name: getNumberOfdays
methods.description: Returns the number of days for interest calculation or related configuration.

methods.name: isSkipRepaymentOnFirstDayofMonth
methods.description: Indicates if repayment should be skipped on the first day of the month.

methods.name: isChangeEmiIfRepaymentDateSameAsDisbursementDateEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if EMI should be changed when repayment date is same as disbursement date.

methods.name: isFirstRepaymentDateAllowedOnHoliday
methods.description: Indicates if the first repayment date can fall on a holiday.

methods.name: isInterestToBeRecoveredFirstWhenGreaterThanEMI
methods.description: Indicates if interest should be recovered first when it exceeds EMI.

methods.name: isPrincipalCompoundingDisabledForOverdueLoans
methods.description: Indicates if principal compounding is disabled for overdue loans.
